works.body:
Nice to meet you, my name is Rugetsupepo.
I saw your picture on Twitter and thought it was wonderful.

I am not a vtuber, but I would like to ask you to create a character that I use in my videos.
He is a 15 year old boy, 155-160 in height, with a slightly more neutral face.
His hair is two-tone white and blue, and he usually looks sleepy.
General drawing reference
https://twitter.com/rugetsupepo/status/1690939483074826240
Reference for facial expression changes
https://twitter.com/rugetsupepo/status/1664293689412435968

I want her to be drawn in a cool and cute atmosphere.
I would like you to include the taiji accessory.
Other details such as clothing, composition, situations, etc. are up to you.
We may use the drawing for icons, headers, YouTube, etc.
I would like to have transparency differences for the characters only.

If you think you can accept the above, please let me know.

Hello! I love the aesthetic your artwork captures!
I was wondering if I could request you to draw my character in the same way as the artworks on your Twitter!

Thank you very much for your consideration!

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1E8ItEhuSxRZVrymHdfzw2pOweBScMoBy/view?usp=sharing
